topic: 口语专项：日常问答与两分钟展开
grammarFocus: 叙事时态、描述从句、原因与例子；减少反复出现的基础错误。
title: Academic Task 2: Speaking Skills and Everyday Conversation
prompt: In many classrooms, speaking practice focuses on short everyday question-and-answer exchanges, yet learners often struggle when asked to sustain a longer turn, such as a two-minute explanation of an idea. Some educators therefore argue that schools and universities should give far more weight to extended spoken production rather than brief conversational routines. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? In your answer, state your position clearly, discuss both short everyday exchanges and longer extended turns, and give your own opinion supported by relevant examples. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。请先明确你的立场（同意、不同意或部分同意），再分别讨论简短日常问答与两分钟长时表达各自的价值与局限，最后给出有例子支撑的个人观点。注意题目要求你讨论双方并表明立场，不要只描述现象；全文不少于250词。
